title: Object-Oriented Abstraction of TETRIS
description: Abstracted the game into pieces using Object-Oriented Programming, making it more optimized, scalable and easy to maintain.

title: Slime Back in Time
description: Inter IIT Tech Meet 13.0 project: In the distant future, scientists have developed a sentient slime which can travel back in time to uncover hidden history of human civilization. Created the jiggle physics system by manipulating basic spring simulation instead of computationally heavy collision-based physics, for realistic yet real-time slime animation and movements.

title: Repercussion — Save Green Planet themed game
description:
• Portraying the need of awareness in Climate Change. A balance between the environment and modernization is required to avoid the planet dying. Developed for INAE GameJam Hackathon 2022.
  • Audience appreciated the smoothness and responsiveness of our game more than other submissions.

title: Souls and Beyond
description: IGDC (event under Inter IIT Tech Meet 11.0) project: a puzzle game based on the themes of Puzzle, Control the Time and Symmetry. Made an efficient way of rendering 1 million polygons in game-scene, eliminating lag.
